name: unidinv
expr: x_s = unidinv(0.5, 6); x_lo = unidinv(0.1, 6); x_hi = unidinv(0.99, 6); x_v = unidinv(ps, 10); x_p0 = unidinv(0, 6); x_p1 = unidinv(1, 6); x_pneg = unidinv(-0.1, 6); x_pover = unidinv(1.5, 6); x_n0 = unidinv(0.5, 0); x_nneg = unidinv(0.5, -1); x_nfrac = unidinv(0.5, 6.5); x_nan = unidinv(NaN, 6); x_nan2 = unidinv(0.5, NaN);
comment: Sig: x = unidinv(p, N). Inverse discrete-uniform CDF on {1..N}: x = ceil(p·N), clamped. Edges: p<=0 or p>1 -> NaN (p=0 has no integer pre-image); N<1 or non-integer N -> NaN; NaN p/N -> NaN. tol=0.
